{
  "summary": "The glucosepane/dityrosine MD pilot successfully establishes numerically stable, reproducible OpenMM model builds and platform-consistent force evaluations across 12 short trajectories (600 ps total), while appropriately disclaiming equilibrium and cross-chemistry mechanical rankings. However, an audit of the sampling design, precision interruption handling, and local readback code (`candidate/local_analysis.py`) identifies five concrete threats to statistical and numerical inference: (1) an unbalanced integration-precision and driver-version switch (`double` in `attempt-001` vs `mixed` in `attempt-002`) occurs solely in `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0, confounding the reported inter-seed variance; (2) the 30-ps `NPT_free` marker analysis applies zero burn-in after releasing a 100 kJ/mol/nm² heavy-solute restraint and reports no autocorrelation or effective sample size diagnostics; (3) the three replicas per model share a single solvent/ion build and minimized starting structure, providing velocity-seed realizations (`df = 0` for solvent/conformational variance) while `GLU_CONTROL` relaxes from a non-equilibrium crosslinked pose; (4) `local_analysis.py` omits periodic minimum-image wrapping on `linkdist` and `maxdev`, computes `final_heavy_solute_displacement_A` without periodic wrapping or rotational/translational alignment, and reconstructs per-frame box dimensions indirectly from density ratios; and (5) `PARAMETER_AUDIT.json` contains four elevated CGenFF dihedral penalties (up to 51.1, vs 30 and 41.1 noted in the text), while the small `DITY` marker SD reflects kinetic trapping within a single rotamer basin over 30 ps rather than statistical convergence.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Unbalanced double-vs-mixed precision and driver switch confounds GLU_CONTROL inter-seed variance",
      "source_file": "evidence/NUMERIC_READBACK.json",
      "source_line": 16,
      "evidence": "In `evidence/NUMERIC_READBACK.json` (lines 9-20) and `candidate/replica_summary.csv` (lines 2-4), `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0 (`attempt-001`, `double` precision, driver `9656f6...` in `candidate/retrieved/resume-metadata.json` line 3) has a Cα marker mean of 10.2110 Å and final temperature 303.85 K, whereas Replicas 1 and 2 (`attempt-002`, `mixed` precision, driver `0dc5f6...`) have means of 12.5252 Å and 11.9192 Å. Meanwhile, `candidate/retrieved/performance-interruption.json` (lines 49-63) shows an unanalyzed 21-ps `double`-precision run of `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 1 already exists in `attempt-001`.",
      "implication": "Pooling one `double`-precision trajectory with two `mixed`-precision trajectories inflates the reported `GLU_CONTROL` sample SD of replica means to 1.2000 Å (versus 0.4285 Å across the two `mixed` replicas alone) and shifts the group mean by -0.6704 Å. The interpretation in `candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` (line 43) that 'glucosepane controls vary substantially between seeds' cannot separate velocity-seed divergence from the precision and driver change.",
      "recommended_check": "Compare the preserved 21-ps `double`-precision trajectory in `attempt-001/run/GLU_CONTROL/replica_1/progress.json` directly against the first 21 ps of `attempt-002/run/GLU_CONTROL/replica_1`, and re-run `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0 (`seed 20261101`) in `mixed` precision under `attempt-002` (~2 min wall time) to establish a balanced 12-replica design.",
      "claim_status": "simulation_result"
    },
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Zero post-restraint burn-in and unquantified autocorrelation in the 30-ps NPT_free window",
      "source_file": "candidate/local_analysis.py",
      "source_line": 54,
      "evidence": "`candidate/local_analysis.py` (lines 25, 54-62) averages all 30 frames saved during `NPT_free` (`assert len(tail)==30`, 1 frame/ps from 21 to 50 ps) immediately after the 100 kJ/mol/nm² heavy-solute restraint is stepped to zero at 20 ps (`candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` line 32), with no equilibration discard and no autocorrelation check.",
      "implication": "Stepping the heavy-atom restraint from 100 kJ/mol/nm² to 0 induces a deterministic relaxation transient—especially in `GLU_CONTROL`, where two unlinked 15-residue chains start from a crosslinked fibril pose (`candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` line 43). Averaging from t = 21 ps mixes transient drift into `free_tail_CA_marker_mean_A` and conflates non-stationary drift with thermal fluctuation in `free_tail_CA_marker_SD_A`.",
      "recommended_check": "Using the existing 30-frame `solute_frames_nm.npy` arrays, compute linear drift slopes, first-half (21-35 ps) versus second-half (36-50 ps) block means, and integrated autocorrelation times (tau_int) to determine the post-release burn-in time and effective sample size (N_eff).",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Shared solvent/minimized build and unrelaxed control pose create pseudo-replication across seeds",
      "source_file": "candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md",
      "source_line": 32,
      "evidence": "Each model uses a single solvent build and minimized starting structure across all three velocity seeds (`candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` line 32), keeps heavy solute atoms restrained for the first 20 ps, and compares `GLU_CONTROL` (+1 e solute charge, 11 Na / 12 Cl, unlinked chains starting in a crosslinked reference pose, lines 15-20, 43) against `GLU_LINKED` (-1 e solute charge, 12 Na / 11 Cl).",
      "implication": "Because heavy solute atoms are restrained during the 20-ps pre-production stages, the three velocity seeds per model cannot randomize backbone conformations or counterion atmospheres prior to the 30-ps readback window (`df = 0` for starting conformer and solvent/ion placement). Paired `LINKED` versus `CONTROL` marker differences additionally confound covalent linkage with a 2 e net charge shift, ion count differences, and asymmetric starting-pose disequilibrium.",
      "recommended_check": "Compute pairwise heavy-atom RMSDs among the three replicas at t = 20 ps (restraint release) to quantify pre-release conformational collapse onto the single minimized pose, and generate independent solvent/ion builds and independently equilibrated unlinked control conformations for future comparisons.",
      "claim_status": "assumption"
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Inconsistent PBC wrapping, unaligned displacement metric, and density-scaled box reconstruction in local_analysis.py",
      "source_file": "candidate/local_analysis.py",
      "source_line": 55,
      "evidence": "In `candidate/local_analysis.py`, line 28 reads only diagonal box lengths from `final_state.xml` and line 55 reconstructs per-frame boxes via `(progress[-1]['density_g_ml']/rec['density_g_ml'])**(1/3)`. Line 56 passes `current_box` to `dist()` for the Cα marker, but lines 42 (`maxdev`), 43 (`final_heavy_solute_displacement_A`), and 57 (`linkdist`) call `dist()` without periodic box wrapping, and line 43 omits rotational/translational alignment.",
      "implication": "`final_heavy_solute_displacement_A` (2.47-3.85 Å in `candidate/replica_summary.csv`) mixes rigid-body center-of-mass translation and rotation during the 30-ps unrestrained NPT stage with internal solute deformation. Furthermore, omitting `current_box` in `linkdist` (line 57) and `maxdev` (line 42) risks periodic-boundary jumps whenever bonded atoms or linked chains wrap across box edges.",
      "recommended_check": "Record exact per-frame `PeriodicBoxVectors` in `progress.json`, pass `current_box` to all `dist()` evaluations in `local_analysis.py` (lines 42, 43, 57), and separate Kabsch-aligned internal heavy-atom RMSD from center-of-mass displacement.",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Unreported 51.1 CGenFF dihedral penalty in audit JSON and kinetic trapping of DITY biaryl torsions",
      "source_file": "candidate/PARAMETER_AUDIT.json",
      "source_line": 98,
      "evidence": "`candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` (line 26) cites two elevated DITY torsion penalty annotations (30 and 41.1), whereas `candidate/PARAMETER_AUDIT.json` (lines 89-104) records four elevated dihedral penalties: 41.1 (line 90), 30.0 (line 94), 51.1 (line 98, `OG312-CA-CG2R67-CG2R67`), and 30.0 (line 102). Meanwhile, `DITY_CONTROL` and `DITY_LINKED` exhibit Cα marker replica SDs of only 0.0616 Å and 0.0733 Å (`evidence/NUMERIC_READBACK.json` lines 40, 55).",
      "implication": "Hindered biaryl (`CG2R67-CG2R67`) torsions in the intramolecular Tyr4-Tyr6 crosslink cannot equilibrate across rotational barriers within 30 ps at 310 K. The ~0.06-0.07 Å inter-replica SD in `DITY` reflects kinetic trapping inside a single initial rotamer basin rather than converged sampling, while the active dihedral parameterization carries high CGenFF analogy penalties.",
      "recommended_check": "Inspect `DITY_LINKED/dry_system.xml` to verify which high-penalty dihedral terms (41.1 vs 51.1) are active on the neutral DITY residue, and compute the time series and range of the `CD2-CE2-CE2-CD2` biaryl dihedral angle across all 30-ps `DITY_LINKED` trajectories to test for single-basin trapping.",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    }
  ],
  "strongest_surviving_claim": "All four solvated collagen-fragment models (`GLU_CONTROL`, `GLU_LINKED`, `DITY_CONTROL`, `DITY_LINKED`) are topologically complete, free of unresolved force-field parameters, consistent between OpenMM Reference (double) and CUDA platforms to ~10^-6 kJ/mol/atom in wet checks, and numerically stable across twelve 50-ps trajectories with zero tracked tetrahedral stereocenter inversions and constraint errors below 10^-6 nm.",
  "decisive_next_experiment": "Priority 1 (Zero-compute diagnostics on existing data): In `candidate/local_analysis.py`, (a) compare the preserved `attempt-001` (`double` precision, 0-21 ps) and `attempt-002` (`mixed` precision, 0-21 ps) trajectories of `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 1; (b) compute linear drift slopes, first-half (21-35 ps) vs second-half (36-50 ps) block means, lag-1 autocorrelation, and integrated autocorrelation times (tau_int) for the Cα-Cα marker and `CD2-CE2-CE2-CD2` biaryl torsion; and (c) fix `local_analysis.py` to apply PBC wrapping to all distances and Kabsch alignment to heavy-atom RMSD. Priority 2 (Minimal balancing simulation, ~2 min wall time): Re-run `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0 (`seed 20261101`) in `mixed` precision under the `attempt-002` driver so all 12 replicas share identical numerical precision and driver code. Priority 3 (Convergence and ensemble extension): Run 3 independent solvent/ion-placement builds per model with independent unlinked native equilibration (at least 10-50 ns unrestrained NPT per replica, or 1D umbrella sampling along the Cα-Cα distance). Controls: Matched `mixed` integration precision and driver hash across all replicas; independent solvent/ion coordinates per replica; explicit recording of exact per-frame periodic box vectors; separation of electrostatic (+1 e vs -1 e) and covalent effects. Recorded observables: True per-frame box vectors, PBC-wrapped Cα-Cα distance, PBC-wrapped crosslink bond length, Kabsch-aligned backbone and heavy-atom RMSDs, and crosslink dihedral angles. Convergence/stop criteria: Discard post-restraint burn-in until reverse-cumulative mean stabilizes within 1 SEM; require effective sample size N_eff = T_prod / (2 * tau_int) >= 20 per replica and agreement between first-half and second-half production block means within 1 SEM. Falsifier: If re-running `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0 in `mixed` precision shifts its Cα marker mean from 10.21 Å into the 11.9-12.5 Å range of Replicas 1-2, the reported 1.20 Å inter-seed SD is falsified as a precision/attempt artifact; if 21-35 ps vs 36-50 ps block means differ significantly or N_eff < 2, stationary sampling within the 30-ps window is falsified.",

    {
      "query": "Chodera JD 2016 Simple method for automated equilibration detection in molecular simulations J Chem Theory Comput",
      "reason": "Provides a standard statistical protocol to determine the post-restraint burn-in discard window and effective sample size (N_eff) from correlated MD time series.",
      "verification_status": "unverified"
    },

      "reason": "Verify whether the neutral joint charge of AGS+LGX (-1e-6 e vs +2 e for native Arg+Lys) in the source Amber99 parameterization is intended for physiological pH and how counterion neutralization was handled in the source fibril simulations.",
      "verification_status": "unverified"
    },

      "reason": "Check whether the source paper validated the high-penalty (30, 41.1, 51.1) CGenFF biaryl dihedral terms against quantum mechanical torsion scans or used them solely as approximate structural tethers.",
      "verification_status": "unverified"
    }
  ]
